schema.title: JSON schema for license report tool configuration file

description:
The license report will be generated in **HTML** format, styled with the custom stylesheet located at `./styles/report.css`. Tables in the report are configured to show borders and to align their content to the centre, as passed through the tableify options. Although CSV output is not the primary format, the delimiter is set to a comma and fields containing the delimiter will not be escaped.

The configuration limits the output to regular **dependencies** only, deliberately excluding **devDependencies**. All look‑ups are performed against the standard NPM registry at `https://registry.npmjs.org/`, but the packages **lodash** and **express** are omitted from the final report. The report will list the following fields in order: `name`, `licenseType`, `author`, and `installedVersion`. A comment is attached with the label **note** and the value “Generated by CI pipeline”. HTTP requests will be retried up to **four** times, waiting **1500 ms** between attempts. The tool reads its package metadata from `./package.json`.
